verdict.rationale: This is a fair question for a local model runner, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that Ollama can run multiple models concurrently, which is a pricing-page claim. Nothing documents any control over how context memory is allocated across concurrent instances, and one community comment says Ollama hides server configuration behind its own defaults.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
